changelog:
[COLOR fffdb515]AI Search (Gemini)[/COLOR]
-Up to five Gemini API keys (before, three). Keys from different Google projects add up their free quota and are used in turn.
-New model Gemini 3.8 Flash, and faster answers from the Flash models.
-Works with the new Google keys (starting with AQ.). Old AIza keys that Google has blocked now show a clear message asking you to create a new one.
-If one key is refused, the next one is tried instead of stopping the search.
-The Gemini 2.5 models, no longer open to new Google projects, come last in the fallback and are skipped when your keys cannot use them.
-Keys pasted with extra spaces now work, and exported logs hide Gemini keys.
[COLOR fffdb515]Settings[/COLOR]
-Every row in Accounts shows the name of its service (Authorize Real-Debrid, Enable TorBox, Easynews Username...), so the page is clear in any skin.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Tools > Show Changelog could appear without a name.
